title: Goety Dimension
description: A Goety-themed magical dimension with five real biomes, custom terrain, void-fluid swamps, and controlled Goety structure generation.
body:
# Goety Dimension / 诡厄维度

## 简介
诡厄维度是一个为 Goety / 诡厄巫法扩展的大型黑紫秘仪风格维度。它保留 `starlit_realm:starlit_realm` 维度 ID，使用自定义 Java 噪声生成器和 5 个独立群系，将 Goety 的方块、结构、树木和暗色魔法主题集中到一个可探索的新世界。

## Features
Goety Dimension adds a Goety-themed magical dimension with custom Java terrain generation, five dedicated biomes, controlled structure placement, and terrain built primarily from Goety blocks.

## 主要内容
- 新维度：`starlit_realm:starlit_realm`
- 5 个群系：虚空沼泽、黑暗森林、秘仪尖峰、咒月荒原、幽晶林
- 虚空沼泽会生成有深度的 Goety 液态虚空沼泽
- 黑暗森林生成 Goety 风格树木，树密度已做节制
- Goety 结构接入：Dark Manor、Crypt、Sorcerous Keep
- 可合成的维度传送核心

## Key Features
- New dimension: `starlit_realm:starlit_realm`
- Five real biomes: Void Swamp, Dark Forest, Arcane Spires, Cursed Moon Wastes, Ghost Crystal Forest
- Deep void-fluid swamp pools using Goety blocks
- Controlled Goety tree and structure generation
- Craftable portal core for entering the dimension

## 兼容性
- Minecraft: 1.20.1
- Loader: Forge 47+
- Java: 17+
- Client/Server: 两端都需要

## Dependencies
- Required: Goety / Goety - The Dark Arts 2.5.53.0+

## 使用
合成并使用“诡厄维度传送核心”进入维度。世界生成变化只会影响新生成区块。

## Known Limitations
Existing chunks will not regenerate. Travel to new chunks or reset the dimension data to see world generation changes.
